sections.title: 你在吃什么？
sections.translation: Children, what are you eating? I am eating an apple. I am eating an orange. I am eating a banana. I am eating a pear. I am eating watermelon. I am eating grapes. I am eating strawberries. I am eating blueberries. Eat more fruit and less candy. I feel my best when I am healthy!

身体健康我最棒: shēn tǐ jiàn kāng wǒ zuì bàng
I feel my best when I am healthy
